record: The frozen production schema the forward-migration checks are run against. This capture is the nightly logical backup taken 2026-11-23T21:52:15Z (backup-database.yml run 45273966448) and independently restore-verified against production: 278/278 functions, every row count and digest matching, auth identities intact. It replaced the 2026-11-15 snapshot, which lacked two functions production actually has (public.resolve_product_classification, public.unit_group_for_base) and therefore failed 0326's proof on a stale baseline rather than on a real gap. The artifact lives only in gitignored backups/; the verification tool loads its schema and skips every data statement. Production is never a migrate target: it is checked against, never written.
dataNote: Measured with the project splitter: 2402 statements total, 467 of them data (all skipped, never executed). The loader also skips scaffold/extension/stub statements — see scripts/lib/baseline.mjs. Contains personal data and password hashes — never commit, never publish. The tool re-measures this count and refuses the record if it does not match.

ledgerOnServer.note: The server's own supabase_migrations bookkeeping at capture time: 118 rows, latest 0324. The repository directory is ahead (296 files and the OTA work up to 0334); that divergence is why batches are verified against a frozen baseline instead of replaying history.

policy.note: No migration file from supabase/migrations may be replayed onto production as history. Production moves only by individually verified NEW files (0303+), at the release gate, through the sanctioned path.
